subject: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing & SLA options
messages:
From: Jon Paxton <jon@skylinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@skylinehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We liked the advanced dashboards and the tracing sampler — both look like they will help our SREs reduce MTTR. We need to bake price and SLA guarantees into our procurement packet by next Friday so Procurement can route to legal.

High-level ask: can you send a succinct commercial proposal (anchor price + two concession options) for:
- Retention extension to 13 months (ingest + storage)
- Full distributed tracing (10k spans/sec peak)
- Advanced dashboard pack (team seats + custom panels)

Budget signal: we have a tough procurement window — target total add-on line item of no more than $95k/year if possible. If there are volume/commitment structures that let us hit that, please show the math.

Also flag any SLA consequences for longer retention (RTOs for archived queries, trace retrieval latency).

Appreciate a short one-pager and a spreadsheet we can attach to our PO.

Best,
Jon Paxton
Head of Platform
Skyline Health

--
Jon Paxton
Skyline Health | Platform & Infrastructure
jon@skylinehealth.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jon Paxton <jon@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing request

Jon — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Attaching a short proposal and a pricing workbook that shows three structured options:

1) Baseline — metered retention to 13 months + standard tracing: $128k/yr (no credits)
2) Commit + credit — 12-month commit, 25% reduction on storage line + 2 months free of dashboard seats: $96k/yr (meets your target if you commit)
3) Pilot concession — 6-month pilot with 40% off first 3 months + performance SLAs ramp: effective first-year ~$78k; then standard pricing unless you convert to commit.

SLA notes: longer retention increases cold-query latencies for archived fragments. We guarantee 99.9% availability for live dashboards and 95% for archival retrieval within 60s (configurable as an add-on). Tracing ingestion and sampling have separate peak throughput guarantees — see the workbook.

Quick clarifying Qs so we can finalize numbers:
- Are you able to sign a 12-month commit if we show the 25% storage credit?
- Is the 10k spans/sec a sustained expected peak or a burst?
- Do you need cross-region replication (EU/DR) for any of this?

I included Ben to confirm technical fit and Laura to attach commercial SOW/DocuSign. If you prefer, we can jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk procurement through the commercial slide.

Attachments: SKYLINE-OBS-PROPOSAL-v1.pdf; retention-pricing-breakdown.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jon Paxton <jon@skylinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing request

Vivek — thanks, the options are helpful. A few notes from Procurement and Platform:

- We cannot sign a 12-month commit without legal review but we could do a 6-month pilot with a conversion clause. That aligns to your Pilot concession (#3).
- 10k spans/sec is our expected sustained peak across our busiest region (western US) — we will need ingestion headroom for scheduled batch jobs.
- No cross-region replication required for this phase.

Counter-proposal for pilot: 6-month pilot, 40% off first 3 months as you suggested, but we need the pilot to include: 50M retained tokens equivalent (so we can validate storage economics), tracing retention at 6 months, and a dashboard seat cap of 25 with the ability to add seats at the pilot price. If the pilot demonstrates value we will convert to a 12-month commit; conversion must lock the 25% storage credit for the duration of the first committed year.

Can you confirm the pilot SLOs (dashboard live availability, trace ingestion durability) and provide a DocuSign-able SOW we can attach to our PO? Procurement wants signatures on the pilot SOW by Fri COB.

Best,
Jon

--
Jon Paxton
Head of Platform
Skyline Health
jon@skylinehealth.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jon Paxton <jon@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing request

Jon — thanks for the clear counter. We can accommodate the pilot structure with the following specifics:

Pilot summary (6 months):
- Retention: 6 months included for tracing; archival extension to 13 months available as an option during conversion.
- Token/storage cap: 50M-token-equivalent included in pilot. Overage rate after pilot: $0.015 per retained token-equivalent.
- Tracing: retention to 6 months for sampled spans; ingestion headroom to handle sustained 12k spans/sec bursts for up to 10 minutes (meets your batch window).
- Dashboards: 25 seats included at pilot price; additional seats can be added during pilot at pilot unit price.
- SLAs during pilot: live dashboard availability 99.8% (monthly), trace ingestion durability 99.95%, archival retrieval SLO best-effort (we guarantee retrieval <90s for warmed archives; cold archives may take up to 4 minutes).

Commercial concessions: first 3 months at 40% off baseline list; tooling/setup credit of $5,000 (one-time) applied on invoice. If you elect to convert to a 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot completion we will honor a 25% storage credit for the first committed year.

Next steps: we have attached a short SOW and a DocuSign stub for signature (docusign-sow-stub.txt). If Procurement can sign by Fri COB we will start onboarding the following Monday and schedule a technical kickoff with Ben to validate ingestion targets.

Attachments: docusign-sow-stub.txt
